assessments.reason: Quorrelith is Buyer; the deposit rises from $240,000 to $360,000, so more of its cash is tied up in escrow at signing. The refund right is unchanged ("returned if a closing condition fails without Buyer's breach"), but the larger sum is exposed if a dispute arises over breach.
assessments.quote: Buyer shall deposit $360,000 with the jointly selected escrow holder upon execution.

assessments.reason: The confidentiality text is identical and only moves from Section 7 to Section 3. The mutual duties are unchanged, so there is no substantive effect on Buyer.
assessments.quote: Each party shall keep the other party's nonpublic business information confidential and use it solely to evaluate or perform this transaction.

assessments.reason: Buyer's closing condition narrows from all required consents to only those for larger contracts. Buyer may have to close without consents on contracts of $50,000 or less in annual charges, which weakens its walk-away protection.
assessments.quote: receipt of contract assignment consents for contracts exceeding $50,000 in annual charges

counter.find: receipt of contract assignment consents for contracts exceeding $50,000 in annual charges
counter.replace: receipt of all required contract assignment consents

assessments.reason: The survival period for Seller's representations extends from eighteen to twenty-four months. Buyer gets a longer window to bring claims for breaches of the title, authority and inventory representations.
assessments.quote: The representations survive for twenty-four months after closing.

assessments.reason: Seller's indemnity cap drops from the full Purchase Price to 10% of it, about $240,000. This sharply limits Buyer's recovery for breaches and retained liabilities.
assessments.quote: Seller's aggregate indemnity liability is capped at 10% of the Purchase Price.

counter.find: is capped at 10% of the Purchase Price
counter.replace: shall not exceed the Purchase Price

assessments.reason: Seller's free transition support doubles from forty to eighty staff hours. Buyer gets more training on the equipment at no extra charge.
assessments.quote: up to eighty staff hours without additional charge

assessments.reason: The change from "after business hours" to "outside business hours" is a wording clarification. It may also cover weekends, but it applies equally to both parties and the effect is minor.
assessments.quote: A notice received outside business hours is effective the next business day.

assessments.reason: Changing "treated as an original" to "deemed an original" is a stylistic change with no substantive effect.
